glossary.rule: One word, capital R, I, Q. Never "Room IQ", "Roomiq", or "ROOMIQ" in prose. The wordmark is spaced caps; prose is not.
The only plan name visible in the product. Name it only as shown. No other tier names.
Market-level view: market picker, Overview, Trends, Forecasts tabs, Explore map. Capitalized.
Property-level deep dive. "the Analyzer" on second mention. Never "analyser".
Underwriting flow for any US address. "the Predictor" on second mention.
Step 5 of the Predictor, marked Pro in the product.
Saved property or market reports that can be re-run.
AI concept images of upgrades on listing photos.
Image-similarity comps. Short form: "visual comps".
The Dashboard map with submarket cells and property dots.
A 0 to 100 score with a letter grade. Never describe its inputs (confirm).
Occupied rooms divided by total rooms. Room-level, never unit-level.
Mean asking rent per room per week. Rents are weekly in this category.
How fast a vacant room is re-leased (confirm formula).
Submarket cell signal from observed occupied rooms.
Occupancy Score bands. "Thin" means too little evidence, never "low demand".
Completeness, history coverage, and media count for one property.
The action label on a property (seen: `Useful benchmark`) plus its recommendation.
Largest average weekly price gap between room segments.
Rooms grouped by bathroom (Private, Shared) or size (Cozy, Standard).
7, 30, and 90-day views of occupancy, daily price, volatility, and deltas.
Observed asking rents times occupancy for a window. Never "income", "earnings", or "collected".
The Predictor's monthly revenue output. Use "forecast" for the output and "baseline profile" for the inputs. Never "baseline" for the output.
Local evidence was thin, so broader comps were used. Always shown with the confidence label.
The forecast's label (seen: Low). Never translate into a percentage.
Plus and minus 10 percent of the forecast. Never "range", "interval", or "bounds".
Automatic choice between the tracked-history path and the bounded underwriting path.
The window of market evidence (default 270 days) behind priors and comps.
Noun: a saved report in My Underwrites. Verb: to run a property through the Predictor.
A watermarked, AI-generated edit of a listing photo. Never "render", "preview of results", or "after photo".
The category, hyphenated as an adjective. Investors search for this phrase.
One word, lowercase, as in the product ("Nearby coliving supply"). Not "co-living" in RoomIQ copy.
The people who rent rooms. Not "members" (a marketplace's own term), not "boarders". Avoid "tenants": legal status varies by state.
The two audiences. Never blend them in one asset. See `reference/icp-personas.md`.
Banned as descriptions of RoomIQ or its category. RoomIQ models weekly room rents, not nightly stays.
Banned as a blanket label. Name the capability: visual comps, AI concepts.

decisions.title: Innovation accounting is the operating model
Lead message is visible evidence, not accuracy
No accuracy claims until a backtest is published
Data source never named or implied
Features are kept apart from UI and other elements

assumptions.assumption: RoomIQ has the rights to display the listing data, photos, and host names it shows, and to make AI derivatives of the photos
assumptions.evidence: None in sources; flagged high priority in S2

assumptions.assumption: Coverage in the Sun Belt preset metros is deep enough that most investor addresses there forecast better than Low confidence
Acquiring investors will run real, live deals through the Predictor instead of only their spreadsheet
assumptions.evidence: Product flow built for it; no user evidence

assumptions.assumption: Forecast error is small enough that investors and lenders act on it
Investors will pay for RoomIQ Pro to reach the Deal Calculator and saved underwrites
Visible uncertainty (formula, support, confidence) increases trust more than it scares buyers off
Education content on room-level underwriting reaches Audience A at low cost
Operators change a room price after seeing segment premiums or visual comps
Investor communities convert to demos when the founder answers questions with worked examples
Saved underwrites and re-runs bring investors back weekly
Activated investors refer a JV partner, lender, or community peer
AI concepts help operators decide on upgrades, rather than being a novelty
Market Score is used to choose markets, not only browsed

experiments.title: Design-partner underwriting sessions
experiments.audience: A, acquiring investors in covered metros
experiments.method: 30-minute founder session per investor; they bring a live deal; the founder runs it through the Predictor with them.
experiments.metric: share of sessions where the investor asks to run a second address or requests access, within 7 days
experiments.also_capture: every objection and phrase verbatim into `ops/signal-log.md`; what else they looked at (competitive)

experiments.title: Forecast backtest
experiments.audience: internal, then lenders if it passes
experiments.method: hold out tracked properties with at least 180 days of history; forecast from earlier evidence; compare to observed.
experiments.metric: median absolute percentage error by confidence label; share of outcomes inside the illustrative scenarios
experiments.threshold_set_before_results: founder sets before running; record here first
experiments.sample: all tracked properties in the seven preset metros meeting the history rule

experiments.title: Deal Calculator paywall interest
experiments.method: in design-partner sessions, show the Pro gate at the Deal Calculator and ask a fixed willingness-to-pay question; no prices quoted until D-11 closes.
experiments.metric: share who say they would pay for Pro to use the Deal Calculator on their next deal

experiments.title: Education content in investor communities
experiments.method: publish 6 "Underwrite the room" pieces over 6 weeks; answer community questions with worked examples; one call to action per piece.
experiments.metric: demos booked from content and community per week, by piece
experiments.threshold_set_before_results: at least 2 qualified demos per week by week 6
experiments.end: 6 weeks after the first piece ships

experiments.title: Coverage audit of preset metros
experiments.method: forecast 20 randomly chosen single-family addresses per preset metro; record support level and confidence.
experiments.metric: share of addresses with better than Low confidence and no fallback support, per metro
experiments.threshold_set_before_results: at least 60 percent in a metro to keep it in demos and targeting

experiments.title: Operator pricing change
experiments.method: five operators review their own comparable property in the Analyzer; follow up after 14 days.
experiments.metric: operators who changed a room price or planned an upgrade because of what they saw
experiments.blocked_by: D-07 puts operators second; starts after EXP-001
